items.name: Sitting too long keeps neck muscles tense
body: That tension builds up through the day

items.name: Take breaks like this
body: Stand up and gently stretch your neck
skip sudden twists or hard stretches

items.name: Forward head posture is a common culprit
body: Every inch your head drifts forward
adds about 10 pounds of extra force

items.name: Fix your posture like this
body: Bring your screen up to eye level
instead of tilting your head down
when you're on a screen for hours

items.name: Your pillow could be part of the problem
body: A pillow that's too high or too flat
which is why mornings can feel worse

headline: If dizziness gets worse with neck movement
or long sitting, your neck may be the cause
Posture fixes and gentle neck stretches
can make a real difference
tip: Keep screens at eye level, take breaks every 30-60 minutes,
and pick a pillow that supports your neck's curve
